summary: Defines the hard multi-tenant boundary of Barkpark: Workspace → Project → Dataset hierarchy with slug-based routing, and token-as-principal membership/authorization model that maps API tokens to workspaces via role-based grants.

intentions.title: Enforce hard workspace tenant isolation
intentions.evidence: Workspace.ex calls itself 'the hard tenant boundary'; auth.ex authorize/3 gates every controller action on membership + permissions; workspace-scoped PubSub topics in content.ex; safe delete path in Workspace moduledoc walks all child resources before CASCADE

intentions.title: Token-first identity model (no user accounts)
intentions.evidence: auth.ex @moduledoc: 'the principal is the API TOKEN — there is NO users/accounts model'; Membership schema principal_type defaults to 'api_token' with room for future kinds; authorize/3 accepts ApiToken struct only

intentions.title: Prevent cross-tenant privilege escalation
intentions.evidence: auth.ex role_for_permissions/1 and create_membership/4 default to 'member' regardless of global token permissions; comments cite bug barkpark-23yi/barkpark-fsko: 'a global-admin token added to workspace B must NOT become admin of B'; workspace_admin?/2 reads the grant row, not global perms

intentions.title: Hierarchical slug-based routing namespace (Workspace → Project → Dataset)
intentions.evidence: Workspace slug unique globally, Project slug unique within workspace, Dataset slug unique within project — mirroring /w/:ws/p/:proj URL structure in router.ex; reserved_slugs list blocks collision with system routes

intentions.title: Additive Dataset entity seam for multi-dataset content isolation
intentions.evidence: Dataset.ex moduledoc 'Wave-2' note: promotes the plain dataset string into a first-class row while keeping the string authoritative for reads; additive only — dataset_id rides alongside until W2 steps flip over; api/CLAUDE.md: scoped reads filter WHERE dataset_id with NO NULL-fallback

intentions.title: Safe cascading workspace deletion with plugin hook propagation
intentions.evidence: Workspace.ex moduledoc documents the canonical delete path: fires Media.delete_file/1, Content.delete_document/1 with plugin hooks before Repo.delete, then Postgres CASCADE; test proves raw Repo.delete leaks orphan blobs and misses hooks
